summary.zh: 可按比例倍量 · 每份皮约 40 g · 大火蒸约 25 分钟
summary.en: Scale up proportionally · about 40 g dough per piece · steam over high heat for about 25 minutes

title.zh: 按糯米粉重量计算的比例
title.en: Percentages by weight of glutinous rice flour

steps.zh: 按需要将基础配方的所有材料乘以同一个倍数。
steps.en: Multiply all ingredients in the base recipe by the same factor as needed.

steps.zh: 大福皮用大火蒸约 25 分钟，每份皮约 40 g，包奶油夹心。
steps.en: Steam the daifuku dough over high heat for about 25 minutes. Use about 40 g dough per piece and wrap it around a cream filling.

steps.zh: 当时为了消耗做夹心的奶油，多蒸了一批皮。
steps.en: A larger batch of dough was steamed at the time to use up the cream intended for the filling.

steps.zh: 这批粉类和牛奶为基础配方的 1.2 倍，糖和黄油当时各用了 20 g。以后以基础配方按比例增减。
steps.en: The flour and milk in this batch were 1.2 times the base recipe; 20 g each of sugar and butter were used. Scale future batches up or down proportionally from the base recipe.

notes.zh: 手写记录未注明奶油夹心的配方、用量，以及黄油加入时机和揉皮步骤。蒸制时间为这次记录，增减批量时需结合实际厚度与熟度判断。
notes.en: The handwritten record does not specify the cream filling recipe or quantity, when to add the butter, or how to knead the dough. The steaming time is from this trial; adjust based on the dough thickness and doneness when changing batch size.
